summary: Black-swan panic detector + hedge router. Consumes 12 panic signals (BTC drawdown, top10 cap drawdown, stablecoin depeg, VIX proxy, SPY/QQQ drawdown, gold, DeFi TVL, plus 5 narrative signals: negative news, social sentiment, smart-money outflow, hotrank churn, AI bearish skew). Maps composite panic_score (0-100) to a hedge allocation tier (calm/alert/black_swan/extreme).
core_logic: Score each signal 0-1 against its threshold; multiply by signal weight; sum to composite panic_score (capped at 100).
Map score to tier: <30 calm, 30-60 alert, 60-80 black_swan, >=80 extreme.
Emit hedge allocation plan: USDC / SQQQon / GLDon / remaining_holdings split per tier.
List unwind conditions for the user to monitor.
recommended_next_step: Review the recommended_allocation; if tier >= alert, prepare swap orders via BAW for the indicated assets.
